title: A maximal-cardinality r-separated finite subset covers the set by closed r-balls
statement: Let X be a pseudometric space (X : Type), K ⊆ X, r ∈ ℝ with 0 ≤ r, and N ∈ ℕ. Assume every finite r-separated set F ⊆ K (r < dist(x, y) for all distinct x, y ∈ F) has card(F) ≤ N. Then there is a finite r-separated set F ⊆ K with K ⊆ ⋃_{x∈F} B̄(x, r), where B̄(x, r) = {z : dist(z, x) ≤ r} is the closed ball.
lean_statement: ∀ (X : Type) [PseudoMetricSpace X] (K : Set X) (r : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 ≤ r → (∀ F : Finset X, (↑F : Set X) ⊆ K → (∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, x ≠ y → r < dist x y) → F.card ≤ N) → ∃ F : Finset X, (↑F : Set X) ⊆ K ∧ (∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, x ≠ y → r < dist x y) ∧ K ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ F, closedBall x r
